name: HTAG Property Intelligence MCP
description: Read-only Australian property intelligence for AI agents: address standardisation, property summaries and estimates, sold/rented listing search, suburb/LGA market metrics, demographics, economics, geographic concordance, and H3 spatial layers - 70+ public tools across three connectors, served over Streamable HTTP.

servers.name: com.htagai/htag-intelligence
servers.description: Read-only property intelligence covering address standardisation, property summaries and estimates, sold/rented listing search, suburb and LGA market metrics, market trends, demographics, economics, and geographic concordance.
servers.toolSummary: Address standardisation, property summaries and price/rent estimates, sold and rented listing search, suburb/LGA market metrics and trends, demographics, economic indicators, and geographic concordance (postcode, suburb, LGA, SA codes). See live tools/list or the API reference for the authoritative inventory.

servers.name: com.htagai/htag-spatial
servers.description: Read-only H3 spatial tools for hex-indexed price, rent and yield surfaces, socio-environmental indicators, risk layers, H3 geometry and resolution utilities, and H3-to-administrative concordance.
servers.toolSummary: H3 hex-indexed price, rent and yield surfaces; socio-environmental indicators and risk layers by H3 cell; H3 geometry and resolution utilities; H3-to-administrative concordance. See live tools/list or the API reference for the authoritative inventory.

servers.name: com.htagai/htag-docs
servers.description: Public capability-discovery connector for listing HTAG MCP servers and their tools, REST API endpoints and OpenAPI operations, and micro-agents. No authentication required.
servers.toolSummary: List HTAG MCP servers and their tools, REST API endpoints and OpenAPI operations, and micro-agents. No authentication required.

notIncluded: Internal / non-public HTAG connectors are intentionally omitted from this public MCP listing.
